items.headline: Flood Warning issued August 13 at 3:06PM AKDT until August 14 at 4:30AM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
Mendenhall Lake gauge levels, along with USGS imagery from Suicide
Basin and water levels within the basin, indicate that the release is
ending. The river has crested around 14.7' and will continue to drop
through the afternoon and evening. The crest will take time to work
down the river but places should start to see water recede in the
next hour. Flooding will continue through this evening until the
river falls out of flood stage late tonight.

* WHAT...Flooding caused by a glacier-dammed lake
items.instruction:
Stay tuned to further developments by listening to your local radio,
television, or NOAA Weather Radio for further information.

Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

items.headline: Heat Advisory issued August 13 at 1:30PM AKDT until August 13 at 10:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Hot temperatures as high as 80 degrees.

* WHERE...Central Arctic Plains and Western Arctic Plains.

* WHEN...Until 10 PM AKDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Individuals not accustomed to these unusually hot
temperatures for this region may experience heat related illnesses.
items.areas: Western Arctic Plains; Central Arctic Plains
items.instruction:
Drink plenty of fluids and check up on elderly and vulnerable
relatives and neighbors.
